lessons.title: What RAG actually is: the open-book exam
lessons.summary: Why a frozen model can't answer questions about your data, why fine-tuning is the wrong fix, and the two clocks (indexing time and query time) that every technique in this course runs on.

lessons.title: The pipeline end to end, and where it breaks
lessons.summary: RAG is five stages bolted together, chunk, embed, index, retrieve, generate, and end-to-end quality is the product of each stage's success rate, not the average. Today we trace the pipeline as a data flow and catalog the specific failure mode native to each stage.
